about.en: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation is a US-based integrated energy and chemical company with upstream oil and gas, product solutions and low carbon solutions businesses. It became the publicly traded parent of the ExxonMobil group after a 2026 redomiciliation merger that moved incorporation from New Jersey to Texas, with shares continuing to trade under the ticker XOM. In tokenized markets, XOM is a common reference equity for products tracking ExxonMobil shares.
